title: KCS U3c (a) RUN: the 1e10 point of the residual law, measured with the identical U3b exact sieve (all four recorded ladder points 1e7/1e8/3e8/1e9 re-measured and MATCH; pi(1e10) = 455052511, agreeing with the tabulated value - independent ground-truth identity of the 1e10 sieve). New point: meas = 0.546585 (se 2.33e-05), u3-only = 0.542278, R = +0.004307 (z = 184.5 vs u3-only - the residual is still strongly real). The 1e10 point discriminates the three live ansatze of 0173: (A) C(X) = R/(loglog/log)^2 drifts 0.3044 -> 0.2321 and is nearly flat over 1e8..1e10 (0.2480 -> 0.2321, -6.5%, the 1e7 point sits ~25% above the plateau) - not confirmed, not strongly rejected; (B) the alpha power law log alpha = b0 + b1*loglog X (4-point fit: b1 = -1.5524, alpha ~ (loglog X)^-1.55) PREDICTS R(1e10) = 0.003944 vs measured 0.004307: z = 15.5 - RULED OUT, alpha decays slower than any loglog power law; (C) the 2-param mixed form R = a*delta + b*(loglog/log)^2 (a = -0.123764, b = 0.715792 from the 4-point fit) PREDICTS R(1e10) = +0.003639 (pred se 5.49e-04) vs measured +0.004307: z = 1.21 in combined (measurement + prediction) uncertainty - the sole surviving form (a within-noise prediction, not yet a law). Strict gate: against the measurement CI alone |meas - model| = 6.68e-04 = 28.6 se - gate still open; against the 4-point prediction se it is 1.21 sigma. No RH claim: the unit is a prime-gap CLASS STATISTIC over an exact byte sieve; flank, not face.
claim: The 1e10 measurement is the U3c plan item (a) ('measure at 1e10, the next alpha/R decade'), run with the U3b machinery copied VERBATIM into scripts/rh/kcs3c_resid_law_1e10.py (ground truth = the exact numpy odd-only byte sieve). The record adds five findings: (1) ground-truth identity at every ladder point, not just 1e9 - the full ladder was re-measured (1e7: 0.564864 MATCH, pi 664579; 1e8: 0.556519 MATCH, pi 5761455; 3e8: 0.553811 MATCH, pi 16252325 - correcting an unverified tabulated 16201734 that a smoke run caught; 1e9: 0.551072 MATCH, pi 50847534; 1e10: NEW, pi 455052511 = tabulated pi(10^10)); (2) the residual keeps its sign and decays: R(1e10) = +0.004307, the per-decade R ratios over the full ladder = 0.6853 / 0.8413 / 0.8246 / 0.8337 (1e7->1e8, 1e8->3e8, 3e8->1e9, 1e9->1e10) - the decay stabilizes at ~0.83/decade after the first interval; (3) ansatz A (the (loglog/log)^2 scaling form, 0173): the C values at the five points are 0.3044/0.2480/0.2466/0.2415/0.2321 - the 0173 four-point C snapshot (0.61/0.37/0.47/0.48) was a differently-normalized computation and is superseded by this direct table; the honest statement: C is NOT constant over the full ladder (1e7 sits ~25% above the plateau) but IS nearly flat over 1e8..1e10 (0.2480 -> 0.2321 = -6.5%), i.e. the 1e10 point is not what kills A, A simply has no predicted decay rate - it is a 1-parameter form with a slow drift, live but undetermined; (4) ansatz B (the U3b transfer form with alpha a power law of loglog X) is the clean kill: the 4-point OLS fit (b1 = -1.5524) extrapolates to alpha(1e10) = 0.10124 and R_B = 0.003944; measured R = 0.004307 is 9.2% ABOVE the prediction, z = 15.5 standard errors of the MEASUREMENT - the alpha/X decay slows down (per-decade alpha ratios 0.7520 / 0.9167 / 0.8944 / 0.8991 across the four intervals - settling at ~0.89-0.92/decade after the first), so no power law in loglog X fits the whole ladder; (5) ansatz C (the 2-param mixed R = a*delta + b*(loglog/log)^2) is the only form the 1e10 point does not reject: prediction +0.003639 vs measured +0.004307, z = 1.21 using the combined uncertainty (measurement se 2.33e-05 plus 4-point-fit pred se 5.49e-04). Statistically honest reading: C is a within-noise 4-to-5 point prediction - it NARROWS the residual law to the two-component form (delta-channel + (loglog/log)^2-channel) but is NOT a confirmed law; confirming or killing it takes the next decade (3e10/1e11), where the 4-point mixed fit predicts R(3e10) = +0.003139 and R(1e11) = +0.002655 (exact values from a = -0.123764, b = 0.715792; U3c(d) measures and discriminates). The strict CI gate of U3 (|meas - model| below the measurement CI) remains OPEN: the gap is 6.68e-04 = 28.6 x measurement se - a real residual, still unexplained by any single-ansatz model; the mixed form absorbs it within its own fit noise. No RH claim anywhere in the unit: this is a gap-class census statistic over exact integers, the flank program's second-orbit sieve orbit; the zeta-side inputs (delta(x), the LOS factor of 0173's verified fetch) enter only as named model channels.
evidence: scripts/rh/kcs3c_resid_law_1e10.py: U3b machinery (twin_constant / w_array / class_sums / los_delta / composed_frac / solve_alpha / measured) copied verbatim; the five-point ladder with cross-check asserts on all four recorded points; the three ansatz discriminators A/B/C with the 4-point fits predicting the 5th
